# The Boomer's AI Passage

> Plain-English guidance on choosing and using AI tools, written for people over 60. Each guide answers "Which AI should I use for this?" with ranked picks, current prices, setup steps and the exact words to type. Rankings use four criteria (does the job well, easy to use, good value, trustworthy) and are never sold. Updated weekly.

## Everyday problems
- [Write a letter or email](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/letter/): our top pick is Claude.
- [Understand a medical bill or insurance letter](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/bill/): our top pick is Claude.

- [Is this text or email a scam?](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/scam/): our top pick is ChatGPT.
- [Plan a trip](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/trip/): our top pick is ChatGPT.
- [Fix or restore old family photos](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/photos/): our top pick is MyHeritage Photo Enhancer.
- [Identify a plant, bird or bug](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/identify/): our top pick is Merlin Bird ID.
- [Read small print or describe things](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/vision/): our top pick is Be My Eyes.
- [Plan meals or cook with what I have](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/meals/): our top pick is ChatGPT.

- [Make something fun for the grandkids](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/grandkids/): our top pick is ChatGPT.
- [Research a big purchase](https://boomersaipassage.com/problems/buy/): our top pick is Perplexity.

## Reference
- [AI word list](https://boomersaipassage.com/words/): plain-English definitions of 32 AI terms
- [Start here: what AI is, what you need, safety rules](https://boomersaipassage.com/start/)
- [Our AI picks and how we rank](https://boomersaipassage.com/picks/)
- [AI agents report card](https://boomersaipassage.com/agents/)
- [AI news this month](https://boomersaipassage.com/news/)
- [Set up AI for Mom and Dad in 20 minutes.](https://boomersaipassage.com/set-up-ai-for-parents/): Install one official AI app (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) on their phone, show them the microphone button, make the text bigger, save a scam-check request in their notes, and leave them a printed guide.
- [Let AI help with Thanksgiving.](https://boomersaipassage.com/thanksgiving/): Open any free AI helper (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini), copy one of the requests below, change the details, and press Enter. It answers in seconds.
- [A gift for Mom, Dad, Grandma or Grandpa who's curious about AI.](https://boomersaipassage.com/gift/): The Boomer's AI Passage handbook: an instant PDF ($19) with 100 things to ask AI, the AI word list, five safety rules and a gift page to sign. Print it or give it on a tablet.
- [How to use ChatGPT, in plain English.](https://boomersaipassage.com/chatgpt-for-seniors/): Go to chatgpt.com on any phone, tablet or computer, type a question in the box at the bottom, and press Enter. The free version is enough to start.
- [Is AI safe? Yes, with five simple rules.](https://boomersaipassage.com/ai-safety/): Yes. Using ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini is safe if you never share passwords or account numbers, double-check health, money and legal answers, and use the official app or website.
